issue.title: Donation page times out before I can finish
body: The donation page gives me 45 seconds. By the time I've listened to the amounts and typed my name, it says my session expired and clears everything.
I also couldn't tell which amount I'd picked, because the buttons don't say. And the monthly checkbox is announced as just "checkbox".

task.instruction: With Screen reader view on, try to donate: choose an amount, enter a name, and press Donate. Keep an eye on the timer above the form.
task.afterReproduce: Made it or not, 45 seconds isn't enough for everyone. The selected amount is shown only by a faint color, and the monthly checkbox has no label.

options.label: Double the time to 90 seconds
options.feedback: Any fixed limit is still a guess about how long people need. Some people will always need more.

options.label: Hide the countdown so it isn't stressful
options.feedback: Now people lose their work with no warning at all.

options.label: Remove the time limit
options.replace: // No time limit: a donation form doesn't need one.
options.feedback: Nothing here needs a time limit, so the best fix is to remove it. If you truly need one, let people turn it off, adjust it, or extend it with a simple action.

fixes.title: The amount buttons
fixes.find: Amount

options.label: Add aria-label="Donate $18" (and so on) to each button
options.replace: Amount
options.feedback: The names are clearer, but which amount is selected is still shown only by color, and screen readers don't hear it at all.

options.label: Add aria-pressed to the buttons
options.replace: Amount
options.feedback: Screen readers now say "pressed" for the chosen amount, and the stylesheet shows a check mark and strong contrast, so it doesn't rely on color.

options.label: Use native radio buttons in a fieldset
options.replace:
<fieldset class="amounts">
          <legend>Amount</legend>
          <label class="amount"><input type="radio" name="amount" value="18"> $18</label>
          <label class="amount"><input type="radio" name="amount" value="36"> $36</label>
          <label class="amount"><input type="radio" name="amount" value="54"> $54</label>
        </fieldset>
options.feedback: Radio buttons are built for "pick one": arrow keys move between them, screen readers say "checked, 2 of 3", and the dot shows the choice without relying on color.

fixes.title: The monthly gift checkbox
fixes.find: Make it a monthly gift

options.label: Add title="Monthly" to the checkbox
options.replace: Make it a monthly gift
options.feedback: A tooltip name only appears on hover, and selecting the words still does nothing.

options.label: Add aria-label="Make it a monthly gift"
options.replace: Make it a monthly gift
options.feedback: Screen readers get a name, but selecting the words still does nothing, so the only target is a tiny box.

options.label: Change the span to a <label for="monthly">
options.replace: <input type="checkbox" id="monthly"> <label for="monthly">Make it a monthly gift</label>
options.feedback: The checkbox has a name, and the whole sentence is now clickable, which makes a much bigger target.

merged.reply: I took my time, picked $36, made it monthly, and nothing expired. See everyone Friday.
learn: Don't add time limits you don't need. If you need one, let people turn it off, adjust it, or extend it.
Selected states must be exposed to assistive technology and shown with more than color.
A visible <label> names a control and makes its text part of the target.
